description: This file defines the EventHubDataAdapter class, which implements the IEventHubDataAdapter interface for integrating Azure Event Hubs with Orleans streams. It provides methods for converting cached messages to batch containers, creating queue messages, extracting stream positions, and encoding message payloads into segments.

classes.name: EventHubDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements event hub data adaptation for Orleans, handling message serialization, deserialization, and conversion between cached messages, batch containers, and event data.

methods.name: EventHubDataAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a serializer.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a cached message into a batch container for streaming.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts an EventHubMessage into a batch container.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Extracts stream sequence token from a cached message.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates EventData for the queue from stream ID, events, token, and request context.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a cached message from queue event data and stream position.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Retrieves stream position from EventData message.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Gets the offset string from a cached message segment.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the partition key for a stream ID.

methods.name: EncodeMessageIntoSegment
methods.description: Encodes EventData payload and properties into a byte segment.
